editorial_intent: A relaxed Lisbon weekend told through five authentic moving scenes: rooftops from a viewpoint, vintage tram, lively pedestrian backstreets, Praça do Comércio and a peaceful Tagus waterfront finish.
share_reason: A tangible, easy European city-break plan friends could send each other, with sights, local streets, trams, shared food and a relaxed riverside finish.
caption:
Lisbon is the kind of city break you can enjoy without a complicated itinerary. 🇵🇹

Start with the viewpoints above Alfama, hop on a yellow tram and leave time to wander the pedestrian streets. Walk through Praça do Comércio, pause for coffee and pastéis de nata, then finish beside the Tagus at Ribeira das Naus.

This is five glimpses of a relaxed weekend, not a rigid route. The older neighbourhoods have steep hills and cobbles, but you can make it easier with public transport and plenty of café stops.

Send this to someone you'd like to get away with. 🌞
